commands.command: cat README.md answer_schema.json items.jsonl

mkdir -p zoom
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
print('Items:',len(items))
for start in range(0,len(items),5):
 rows=[]
 for n,it in enumerate(items[start:start+5],start+1):
  w=Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB'); l=Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
  canvas=Image.new('RGB',(max(w.width,l.width,1000),w.height+l.height+40),'white')
  ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((5,3),str(n)+' '+it['item_id'],fill='black')
  canvas.paste(w,(0,25));canvas.paste(l,(0,30+w.height));rows.append(canvas)
 out=Image.new('RGB',(max(r.width for r in rows),sum(r.height for r in rows)+20*(len(rows)-1)), '#dddddd'); y=0
 for r in rows:out.paste(r,(0,y));y+=r.height+20
 out.save(f'zoom/b{start+1:03}.png')
PY
